From original BASIC lines 3515-3560:
5 moves left and advances down one row.
8 moves right and advances down one row.
6 advances down one row.
H calls the help routine. We did not test H.

Replay timing with Fuse 48K at 250%: load original TreasureIsland.tap using --auto-load --tape. Wait 2.5 seconds. Press R for 0.12 seconds and ENTER for 0.12 seconds, each followed by a 0.20 second release wait. Wait 3 seconds. Save the first island map. Press 5 for 0.16 seconds, release for 0.20 seconds, wait 1.3 seconds and capture. Do the same with 8 and then 6. The map is random, so pictures can differ between runs.

We saw the active island map and screen changes after the keys. No complete treasure hunt or finished round is claimed.
